parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-22 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 177.3 | 1.37 | 1.37
2 | 706.0 | 5.88 | 7.25
3 | 3320.1 | 2.09 | 9.34
4 | 3433.8 | 1.21 | 10.55
5 | 794.3 | 10.44 | 20.99
6 | 9531.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AAKH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-22
Curve type: AAKH
Aquifer depth: 10.55 - 20.99 m
Recommendation: Target the potentially saturated zone between 10.55m and 20.99m. Drill to a minimum depth of 21m to ensure full penetration of the target layer before the basement contact.
